doc.name: Agentosaurus
doc.instructions: Agentosaurus sells change-control Reviews for AI agents, a policy gateway for teams on Claude Code, LOGOS retainers and sovereign training runs, and keeps a public directory of sustainability organisations and volunteer shifts. Every tool reads published data only; signup, request_scoping_call and request_data_removal are the three that record anything, and a person answers them.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.title: Training-run price list
tools.description: Published prices for each stage of a sovereign training run at each model size, for both architectures, with their assumptions. Same data as /agents/pricing.json.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.title: Quote one model size
tools.description: An itemised quote for one model size, with dataset-only, dataset-plus-compute and selection totals. Same data as /agents/quote.json.

expert_rate.description: USD per expert hour. Send this or novelty, not both.

tools.name: get_review_scope
tools.title: The Review: scope and plan
tools.description: The change-control Review (the Audit): its scope, the plan by week, what you receive and how the price is set. Same text as /agents/audit.txt.

tools.name: get_policy_gateway_offer
tools.title: The policy gateway for Claude Code
tools.description: The policy gateway offer: policy research, enforcement on every Claude Code tool call through hooks, a human approvals queue, a tamper-evident decision log and a weekly report per team; how a team switches it on through managed settings; the four tiers; and what is collected. Same text as /policy-gateway.txt.

annotations.title: The policy gateway for Claude Code

tools.name: list_nodes
tools.title: Sovereign GPU node builds
tools.description: GPU node builds a buyer owns and Agentosaurus racks in Amsterdam, with build totals, the minimum order, monthly colocation and energy factors. Same data as /agents/nodes.json.

tools.name: estimate_pretraining_cost
tools.title: Pretraining cost for a model shape
tools.description: What pretraining a model of a given shape costs at the published rates: token budget, GPU hours, run schedule and the total. The same arithmetic as the /cost/ calculator and /agents/model.json.

active_params.description: Parameters active per token. Defaults to total_params (dense).

annotations.title: Pretraining cost for a model shape

tools.description: What a full VerifyAgent ESG due-diligence report contains and costs, with the upgrade and investigate pages.

tools.name: signup
tools.title: Register an email address
tools.description: Registers an email address with Agentosaurus, optionally with an interest. We email the person a link to confirm; nothing is stored as consent until they click it. A person replies after that. Charges nothing. Limited to 5 per hour per address.

note.description: Passed to the person who replies once the address is confirmed, then deleted.

tools.name: request_scoping_call
tools.title: Request a scoping call
tools.description: Asks Agentosaurus for a scoping call about the Review, the policy gateway (tier policy_gateway, Starter included), LOGOS or sovereign training. We email the person a link to confirm; nothing is stored as consent until they click it. A person replies by email after that. Charges nothing. Limited to 5 per hour per address.

privacy_consent.description: Ignored. Consent comes only from the person clicking the emailed link.

tools.name: request_data_removal
tools.title: Ask to remove or correct data
tools.description: Asks Agentosaurus to delete or fix someone's personal data, or to take down an organisation's listing, for the requester or for someone they act for. We email the requester's address a link to confirm; nothing is stored as consent until they click it, and the request is acted on after that. A person reviews it and replies by email within one month; nothing is removed automatically. Returns a reference code only. Limited to 5 per hour per address.

target_url_or_slug.description: The page URL or organisation slug the request is about.

on_behalf_of.description: The person or organisation the requester acts for.

submitted_by_agent.description: An AI agent is sending this request.

annotations.title: Ask to remove or correct data
